title: 练枪训练 · 今日清单（Day N）

list.name: day
list.label: 清单
list.query:
from(bucket: "aim") |> range(start: -1y, stop: 2d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "aim_daylist_meta" and r._field == "items")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "daylist"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> rename(columns: {daylist: "_value"}) |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

list.name: scenario
list.label: 场景
list.query:
from(bucket: "aim") |> range(start: -1y, stop: 2d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "aim_daylist" and r._field == "order" and r.daylist == "$day")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "scenario"]) |> sort(columns: ["_value"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r.scenario })) |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

list.name: rundate
list.label: 清单日

panels.title: 今日清单 · 完成度（要求轮数 vs 已打）
panels.description: 数据源：aim_daylist（清单要求）+ aim_scenario（清单日当天实际次数）

targets.query:
option location = {zone: "Asia/Shanghai", offset: 8h}
_rd = "${rundate}"
_cs = if _rd == "" then v.timeRangeStart else time(v: _rd + "T00:00:00+08:00")
_ce = if _rd == "" then v.timeRangeStop else time(v: _rd + "T23:59:59+08:00")
from(bucket: "aim")
  |> range(start: _cs, stop: _ce)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "aim_scenario" and r._field == "score" and r.list == "viscose-s2-easier")
  |> group(columns: ["scenario"]) |> count()

panels.title: 今日清单 · 目标对比（清单目标 vs 现状）
panels.description: 每行一个场景：清单目标分 / 下一档线 / 命中率门槛 vs 现状（蓝条=现状÷目标）
